searchText: To clarify, the constants here will be part of the config and thus configurable at runtime? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/11a037fd9227e29ee809c9397b09f8cc3383a8c0/specs/eip4844/p2p-interface.md#configuration If not I think they should, specially `MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOBS_SIDECARS_REQUESTS` is a critical parameter that should be customizable per network it is listed as "configuration" i think this is the key bit from the spec: > After EIP4844_FORK_EPOCH, BeaconBlocksByRootV2 is replaced by BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRootV1 clients MUST support requesting blocks by root for pre-fork-epoch blocks. hmm ok it looks like we are keeping `BeaconBlocksByRootV2` and then imo this statement is confusing <@363800010518822915> what did you have in mind here? can we reword this bit i quoted? or just remove it? I think we can remove it but clients do want to support blocks by root request for pre 4844 fork blocks. Not sure where is the best place to explicitly state that i was thinking we would add a `context` value so that `BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRootV1` would *also* provide pre-4844 data otherwise we should just have both and then i think we should remove that quoted stmt Either option sounds great to me. I don't have a strong preference. Do you have a preference?

excerpts.author: dapplion
excerpts.content:
To clarify, the constants here will be part of the config and thus configurable at runtime? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/11a037fd9227e29ee809c9397b09f8cc3383a8c0/specs/eip4844/p2p-interface.md#configuration
If not I think they should, specially `MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOBS_SIDECARS_REQUESTS` is a critical parameter that should be customizable per network

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content:
i think this is the key bit from the spec:

> After EIP4844_FORK_EPOCH, BeaconBlocksByRootV2 is replaced by BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRootV1 clients MUST support requesting blocks by root for pre-fork-epoch blocks.

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content:
hmm ok it looks like we are keeping `BeaconBlocksByRootV2`  and then imo this statement is confusing

<@363800010518822915> what did you have in mind here? can we reword this bit i quoted? or just remove it?

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content: I think we can remove it but clients do want to support blocks by root request for pre 4844 fork blocks. Not sure where is the best place to explicitly state that

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: i was thinking we would add a `context` value so that `BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRootV1` would *also* provide pre-4844 data

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: otherwise we should just have both and then i think we should remove that quoted stmt

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content: Either option sounds great to me. I don't have a strong preference. Do you have a preference?
